recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中三系造血都在：左下有一顆成熟巨核細胞，顆粒球由前骨髓細胞到分葉核依序成熟，並夾雜濃縮圓核的紅血球母細胞，沒有原始細胞增多或明顯發育不良，屬於反應性骨髓。
features: Trilineage hematopoiesis with a mature megakaryocyte present
Granulocytic series showing full orderly maturation from promyelocytes to segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and polychromatic cytoplasm, maturing normally
No increase in blasts; scattered promyelocytes with azurophilic granules
No overt dysplastic features in neutrophils or erythroid cells in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular spicule trails with trilineage hematopoiesis. Granulocytic precursors show complete, orderly maturation to segmented neutrophils, erythroid precursors mature normally, and a morphologically unremarkable megakaryocyte is present. Blasts are not increased and no significant dysplasia is identified. Findings are consistent with a reactive/benign bone marrow aspirate.

ddx.vs: Would show dysplasia in ≥10% of cells of a lineage, such as hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, megaloblastoid erythroids or small hypolobated megakaryocytes, which are absent here.
Shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with a myelocyte and neutrophil bulge, basophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes, rather than the balanced trilineage picture seen here.
Features an increase in blasts (≥20%) replacing normal maturation, which is not present in this field.
